Optional public administration paper-1-2026

SECTION A

1. Answer the following questions in about 150 words each: (10 × 5 = 50 Marks)

* (a) "There is an urgent need to incorporate the contribution of other disciplines into debates and analyses about governance, not the prevalence of disciplinary silos." Comment. (5+5=10 Marks)
* (b) The ideas of Frederick Taylor remain highly relevant in today's business world, in both the public and private sectors, including the 'gig economy'. Comment. (5+5=10 Marks)
* (c) A transparent organisation keeps the staff in the loop. Describe. (10 Marks)
* (d) Have governments under governance become more transparent and accountable? Elucidate. (3+7=10 Marks)
* (e) "Dicey's three principles of the 'Rule of Law' have been further developed to meet the immense needs of a democratic society." Discuss. (5+5=10 Marks)

2.

* (a) Different paradigms of public administration deal with the questions of 'How' and 'Why', but do not negate the centrality of the discipline. Discuss. (10+10=20 Marks)
* (b) Douglas McGregor's 'Professional Manager' is a rational, emotive individual whose primary role is to work through the differences and build a managerial team. Explain how his idea of the 'Professional Manager' is distinct from Theory 'Y'. (7+8=15 Marks)
* (c) Individuals' perception of fairness and equity at the workplace motivates them to give their best. How can fairness and equity be reinforced to improve productivity in an entity? Discuss. (10+5=15 Marks)

3.

* (a) Bureaucratic features have remained constant in organisations despite the development of different forms under NPM and Public Governance approaches. Give reasons for the persistence of these bureaucratic features. (10+10=20 Marks)
* (b) There is no single best way to manage an organisation. Instead, it is about the optimal structure and strategic fit between the organisation's internal sub-systems and its dynamic external environment. Elucidate. (5+10=15 Marks)
* (c) The fine demarcation between judicial control and judicial overreach disappears when judicial prudence is replaced by activism. Critically examine. (5+10=15 Marks)

4.

* (a) Abraham Maslow propounded the theory of needs, which identified the basic needs that human beings have in order of their importance. McClelland believes that we all have three motivators, and individuals with different motivators exhibit distinct characteristics. Critically examine. (10+10=20 Marks)
* (b) Critically analyse the differences between Ferrel Heady's focus on administrative structures and Fred Riggs's ecological 'Prismatic' model. Which one of these frameworks provides a more effective tool for the study of developing nations? Examine. (7+8=15 Marks)
* (c) New communication technology has not only enabled more robust public engagement with the government, but also serves as a new means of internal organizational teamwork. Discuss. (5+10=15 Marks)

---

SECTION B

5. Answer the following questions in about 150 words each: (10 × 5 = 50 Marks)

* (a) The objective of policy sciences is to develop policy knowledge for better policy-making. Comment. (10 Marks)
* (b) Administrative ethics is an abstract concept, and in practice, is an unresolved dilemma between 'what is' and 'what ought to be'. Comment. (10 Marks)
* (c) Is state-led development an artificial distortion of market forces? Analyse. (10 Marks)
* (d) "No tax shall be levied or collected except by authority of law." Analyse. (10 Marks)
* (e) Work study and Work measurement are techniques for improving administrative efficiency. Comment. (10 Marks)

6.

इंडियन इन्स्टिट्यूट ऑफ टेक्नॉलॉजी (IIT) मद्रासच्या सुधा गोपालकृष्णन ब्रेन सेंटर मधील शास्त्रज्ञांनी मानवी ब्रेनस्टेमचा (मेंदूचा एक भाग) जगातील सर्वात तपशीलवार आणि अचूक ३D डिजिटल नकाशा विकसित केला. याला 'ANCHOR' (Atlas of Neurochemical Characterisation of the Human Brainstem with 3D Reconstruction) असे नाव देण्यात आले आहे.

या 3D नकाशाबद्दलची काही महत्त्वाची माहिती खालीलप्रमाणे आहे:

तपशील (Details): या नकाशात २०० पेक्षा जास्त छोट्या संरचना (न्यूक्ली आणि फायबर ट्रॅक्ट्स) अतिशय सूक्ष्म पातळीवर मॅप केल्या आहेत.

वय (Age Range): यात गर्भातील २५ आठवड्यांच्या बाळापासून ते ९ वर्षे आणि ५४ वर्षे वयाच्या व्यक्तीच्या ब्रेनस्टेमच्या विकासाचा अभ्यास समाविष्ट आहे.

ब्रेनस्टेमचे कार्य: हा भाग मेंदूला पाठीच्या कण्याशी जोडतो. तसेच श्वासोच्छ्वास, हृदय गती आणि झोप यांसारख्या जीवन आवश्यक गोष्टी नियंत्रित करतो.

उपयोग: हा नकाशा जगभरातील डॉक्टर आणि संशोधकांसाठी मोफत उपलब्ध करून दिला आहे. यामुळे मस्तिष्क (brain) आणि तंत्रिका प्रणालीशी (nervous system) संबंधित आजारांचा अभ्यास करणे सोपे होईल.

1 .Who did R. Praggnanandhaa defeat in the final of the 2026 Grand Chess Tour held in St. Louis (USA) to win the title?
सेंट लुइस (अमेरिका) में आयोजित 2026 ग्रैंड चेस टूर के फाइनल में आर. प्रज्ञानानंद ने किसे हराकर खिताब जीता?
Answer: -   Fabiano Caruana (USA) / फैबियानो कारुआना (अमेरिका)

2 .Which Indian squash player won the Budapest Squash Open title in August 2026?
अगस्त 2026 में किस भारतीय स्क्वैश खिलाड़ी ने बुडापेस्ट स्क्वैश ओपन का खिताब जीता?
Answer: -   Velavan Senthilkumar / वेलावन सेंथिलकुमार

3 .At what position did the Indian women's hockey team finish in the FIH Women's Hockey World Cup 2026, marking their best performance since 1974?
एफआईएच महिला हॉकी विश्व कप 2026 में भारतीय महिला हॉकी टीम किस स्थान पर रही, जो 1974 के बाद उसका सर्वश्रेष्ठ प्रदर्शन है?
Answer: -   5th Place / 5वां स्थान

4 .Which legendary tennis player was inducted into the International Tennis Hall of Fame in August 2026?
अगस्त 2026 में किस महान टेनिस खिलाड़ी को इंटरनेशनल टेनिस हॉल ऑफ फेम में शामिल किया गया?
Answer: -   Roger Federer / रोजर फेडरर

5 .India recently signed a Letter of Offer and Acceptance (LOA) with which country to purchase the Javelin Anti-Tank Guided Missile System?
भारत ने हाल ही में किस देश से जैवलिन एंटी-टैंक गाइडेड मिसाइल सिस्टम खरीदने के लिए लेटर ऑफ ऑफर एंड एक्सेप्टेंस (LOA) पर हस्ताक्षर किए?
Answer: -   United States (USA) / संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका (यूएसए)

6 .Where was the first meeting of the India-Kuwait Joint Defence Committee held in August 2026?
अगस्त 2026 में भारत-कुवैत संयुक्त रक्षा समिति (Joint Defence Committee) की पहली बैठक कहाँ आयोजित की गई?
Answer: -   New Delhi / नई दिल्ली

7 .Who took over as the new King of Norway (King Haakon VIII) following the passing of King Harald V in August 2026?
अगस्त 2026 में किंग हेराल्ड पंचम के निधन के बाद नॉर्वे के नए सम्राट (King Haakon VIII) के रूप में किसने पदभार संभाला?
Answer: -   Crown Prince Haakon /  क्राउन प्रिंस हाकोन

8 .Who was appointed as the new Director and Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of TVS Motor Company?
टीवीएस मोटर कंपनी  के नए निदेशक और मुख्य कार्यकारी अधिकारी (CEO) के रूप में किसे नियुक्त किया गया?
Answer: -   Peyman Kargar / पेयमन कारगार

9 .Who was appointed as the Joint Secretary in the National Testing Agency (NTA) for a five-year term?
राष्ट्रीय परीक्षण एजेंसी (NTA) में पांच वर्ष के कार्यकाल के लिए संयुक्त सचिव के रूप में किसे नियुक्त किया गया?
Answer: -   Anshuman Sharma / अंशुमन शर्मा

10 .Which digital and telecom company received SEBI approval for India's largest IPO worth around ₹37,700 crore ($4 billion) in August 2026?
अगस्त 2026 में किस डिजिटल व टेलीकॉम कंपनी को करीब 37,700 करोड़ रुपये ($4 बिलियन) के भारत के सबसे बड़े आईपीओ (IPO) के लिए सेबी (SEBI) की मंजूरी मिली?
Answer: -   Jio Platforms Limited / जियो प्लेटफॉर्म्स लिमिटेड

11 .What is the name of the central scheme launched to replace BS-IV and older commercial trucks and buses with BS-VI or electric vehicles in Delhi-NCR?
दिल्ली-एनसीआर में बीएस-IV और उससे पुराने वाणिज्यिक ट्रकों और बसों को बीएस-VI या इलेक्ट्रिक वाहनों से बदलने के लिए शुरू की गई केंद्रीय योजना का नाम क्या है?
Answer: -   PARIVARTAN Scheme / परिवर्तन (PARIVARTAN) योजना

12 .Which scheme has been announced by the Delhi Government to provide financial assistance of ₹2.40 lakh per year to set up recreation and wellness centres for senior citizens?
दिल्ली सरकार ने वरिष्ठ नागरिकों के लिए मनोरंजन और स्वास्थ्य केंद्र स्थापित करने हेतु प्रतिवर्ष ₹2.40 लाख की वित्तीय सहायता देने के लिए किस योजना की घोषणा की है?
Answer: -   Vayo Anand Scheme / वयो आनंद योजना

➼ 2026 SCO Council of Heads of State Summit की मेजबानी Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan करेगा।
The 2026 SCO Council of Heads of State Summit will be hosted by Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan.

➼ Odisha सरकार ने delayed public services के लिए Auto-Appeal System लागू किया और अधिकारियों पर ₹250 प्रतिदिन, अधिकतम ₹5,000 penalty का प्रावधान किया।
The Odisha Government introduced an Auto-Appeal System and a penalty of ₹250 per day, up to ₹5,000, for delays in public services.

➼ Department of Posts ने Daak Mitra और Daak Seva नाम के दो नए mobile apps लॉन्च किए।
The Department of Posts launched two new mobile applications, Daak Mitra and Daak Seva.

➼ Medical Devices Rules, 2017 के Rule 63 में clinical investigation exemption के लिए European Union (EU) को शामिल किया गया।
The European Union (EU) was included under Rule 63 of the Medical Devices Rules, 2017 for waiving local clinical investigations.

➼ Tamil Nadu ने परिवारों को सालाना तीन free LPG cylinders देने के लिए Annapoorani Super Six Scheme की घोषणा की।
Tamil Nadu announced the Annapoorani Super Six Scheme to provide three free LPG cooking gas cylinders annually to families.

➼ प्राचीन Mauryan-era Buddhist site Vaishya Tekri Ujjain, Madhya Pradesh में स्थित है।
The ancient Mauryan-era Buddhist site Vaishya Tekri is located in Ujjain, Madhya Pradesh.

➼ TCS ने Porsche AG की IT consulting subsidiary MHP में 100% stake acquire किया।
TCS acquired a 100% stake in MHP, the IT consulting subsidiary of Porsche AG.

➼ Samrasata Sankalp Abhiyan Sant Shiromani Ravidas की 650th Birth Anniversary के उपलक्ष्य में आयोजित किया गया।
The Samrasata Sankalp Abhiyan was organised to commemorate the 650th birth anniversary of Sant Shiromani Ravidas.
